verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Figma Make using data as context for building apps: backend creation, MCP-connected documents, tasks and data, and web search to ground the app. None of it documents the AI analyzing a user's data to surface insights or suggestions. Planning and grounding features are adjacent to this story, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
